te: Having already been elected to the throne of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1587, Sigismund III of the House of …
dz: 瓦萨王室的西吉斯蒙德三世已于 1587 年当选波兰立陶宛联邦王位，并于 1592 年继承其父亲瑞典国王约翰三世加冕为瑞典国王。
de: Having already been elected to the throne of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1587, Sigismund III of the House of Vasa is crowned King of Sweden, having succeeded his father John III of Sweden in 1592.

t: 亨利四世被加冕为法国国王.
te: Henry IV is crowned King of France.
dz: 亨利四世被加冕为法国国王.
de: Henry IV is crowned King of France.

t: 被西班牙人所持有的荷兰城市"克夫登"(Coevorden)倒下为一股荷兰和英国势力.
te: The Dutch city of Coevorden, held by the Spanish, falls to a Dutch and English force.
dz: 被西班牙人所持有的荷兰城市"克夫登"(Coevorden)倒下为一股荷兰和英国势力.
de: The Dutch city of Coevorden, held by the Spanish, falls to a Dutch and English force.

t: 腓力二世承认了菲律宾当地贵族和酋长的权利和特权,这为菲律宾本土贵族的精英统治阶级(西班牙裔菲律…
te: Philip II recognizes the rights and privileges of the local nobles and chieftains in the Philippines, which paved way t…
dz: 腓力二世承认了菲律宾当地贵族和酋长的权利和特权,这为菲律宾本土贵族的精英统治阶级(西班牙裔菲律宾人)的统治稳定铺平了道路.
de: Philip II recognizes the rights and privileges of the local nobles and chieftains in the Philippines, which paved way to the stabilization of the rule of the Principalía (an elite ruling class of native nobility in Spanish Philippines).

t: (原始内容存档于2013-10-12). The Action of Faial, Azore…
te: The Action of Faial, Azores. The Portuguese carrack Cinco Chagas, loaded with slaves and treasure, is attacked and sunk…
dz: (原始内容存档于2013-10-12). The Action of Faial, Azores. 装有奴隶和宝藏的葡萄牙卡拉克Cinco Cagas被英国船只攻击并被击沉,船上700多人中只有13名幸存者.
de: The Action of Faial, Azores. The Portuguese carrack Cinco Chagas, loaded with slaves and treasure, is attacked and sunk by English ships with only 13 survivors out of over 700 on board.

t: 佩德罗·洛佩斯·德索萨指挥下的葡萄牙军队在斯里兰卡丹图尔战役期间开始入侵康提王国，但没有成功。
te: Portuguese forces under the command of Pedro Lopes de Sousa begin an unsuccessful invasion of the Kingdom of Kandy duri…
dz: 佩德罗·洛佩斯·德索萨指挥下的葡萄牙军队在斯里兰卡丹图尔战役期间开始入侵康提王国，但没有成功。
de: Portuguese forces under the command of Pedro Lopes de Sousa begin an unsuccessful invasion of the Kingdom of Kandy during the Campaign of Danture in Sri Lanka.

t: 荷兰的格罗宁根城被西班牙人所防御,被奥兰治的莫里斯手下的一支荷兰和英格兰军队所围困,投降.
te: The Dutch city of Groningen defended by the Spanish and besieged by a Dutch and English army under Maurice of Orange, c…
dz: 荷兰的格罗宁根城被西班牙人所防御,被奥兰治的莫里斯手下的一支荷兰和英格兰军队所围困,投降.
de: The Dutch city of Groningen defended by the Spanish and besieged by a Dutch and English army under Maurice of Orange, capitulates.

t: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世在施特灵城堡的亨利亲王受洗处举行出场仪式.
te: King James VI of Scotland holds a masque at the baptism of Prince Henry at Stirling Castle.
dz: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世在施特灵城堡的亨利亲王受洗处举行出场仪式.
de: King James VI of Scotland holds a masque at the baptism of Prince Henry at Stirling Castle.

t: 葡萄牙帝国军队在斯里兰卡被击败，丹图尔战役结束。
te: Troops of the Portuguese Empire are defeated on Sri Lanka, bringing an end to the Campaign of Danture.
dz: 葡萄牙帝国军队在斯里兰卡被击败，丹图尔战役结束。
de: Troops of the Portuguese Empire are defeated on Sri Lanka, bringing an end to the Campaign of Danture.
